title: Deploying Prisma in CI/CD
description: Deploy Prisma migrations and Prisma Client in CI/CD pipelines for production releases.

data.text: Deploying Prisma in CI/CD requires running migrations against the production database and regenerating Prisma Client as part of the build process.
Prisma Client must be regenerated at build time to reflect the latest schema. This happens automatically during `prisma migrate deploy`.

data.title: CI/CD Step
data.content: Deploy migrations and generate Prisma Client in CI.
data.code:
# Install dependencies
npm ci

# Generate Prisma Client
npx prisma generate

# Run migrations
npx prisma migrate deploy

# Build Next.js
npm run build

data.text: Ensure `DATABASE_URL` is set in your CI/CD environment. For production, use a secure secrets manager rather than plain environment variables.

data.title: Important
data.text: Always run `prisma migrate deploy` before `npm run build`. This ensures the database schema is up to date and Prisma Client types match the database.
